rules.statement: There is no statutory bar to partition several lands held in common, but common ownership need to prevail in respect of all lands.
rules.supporting_quote: There is no statutory bar to partition several lands held in Common. The deciding factor seems to be that common ownership need to prevail in respect of all lands.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 26(4) of Partition Law No. 21 of 1977
